channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

item.title: Rupee falls 16 paise to 96.13 against U.S. dollar in early trade
item.description: Forex traders said the rupee is under pressure largely due to the combination of firm oil and rising U.S. nominal and real yields, which together are drawing portfolio flows out of emerging markets, including India

item.title: V.D. Satheesan govt faces first major electoral test as counting on in 38 local body wards across 12 districts in Keralam
item.description: Results could have significant consequences for UDF, LDF Opposition and BJP-led NDA

item.title: Rima Das on ‘Village Rockstars 2’ and the state of independent cinema
item.description: The acclaimed Assamese filmmaker opens up about the delayed theatrical release of ‘Village Rockstars 2’, making films featuring children and nature, the need to build a better system to support cinema from the Northeast and more.

item.title: Lack of understanding about cross-border terror concerns impacts bilateral ties: Jaishankar on India-U.S. relations
item.description: External Affairs Minister S. v says terrorism from Pakistan is a primary Indian concern, and its lack of full appreciation by partners affects ties, amid warming Washington-Islamabad relations

item.title: CEC row LIVE: Former Home Secretary urges Opposition to boycott elections until Gyanesh Kumar resigns
item.description: Congress Working Committee to meet today (September 29) to discuss the “internal differences” in the ECI

item.title: Karnataka SIR: Over 4,000 Form-7 seek deletion of names, largely Muslim voters, across Congress, BJP seats
item.description: In Babaleshwar alone, 1,373 Form-7 applications were received on September 22. Of these, 1,363 were filed by just 10 people, seeking deletions largely against Muslim voters outside their own polling stations

item.title: PMO reviews Ambedkarite writings in university curricula after anonymous post calls them ‘poison’
item.description: Academic Kancha Ilaiah Shepherd questions the interference of the PMO in the syllabus of universities, which ought to be in the purview of the Department of Higher Education or University Grants Commission

item.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay declares open renovated Gandhi Memorial Museum in Madurai
item.description: The renovation work was carried out at a total cost of ₹10.25 crore by the Heritage Wing of the Public Works Department

item.title: Cancer, kidney, AIDS drugs sold at up to 70 times procurement cost: Karnataka Health Minister
item.description: He sought a national study comparing the printed MRP, manufacturer/importer price, hospital’s net acquisition price, and the price ultimately billed to patients for selected high-value medicines, medical devices, and consumables

item.title: Jharkhand BJP strongly condemn the damage to Syama Prasad Mookerjee’s statue in Ranchi
item.description: Police lodged the FIR under sections 324, 298, 196, 352, and 356 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act, 1971

item.title: Over 40 modules of Shahzad Bhatti network busted, 350 held across 15 States: Amit Shah

item.title: Locals symbolically ‘open’ Bengaluru Metro Pink Line, demand early launch
item.description: The protest came as the Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Ltd. missed its September-end target for opening the 7.5-km elevated stretch between Kalena Agrahara and Tavarekere

item.title: Ex-Home Secretary R.K. Singh accuses CEC Gyanesh Kumar of ‘illegalities’ in SIR

item.title: AAP donations plunge in 2025-26; company of MP who later joined BJP, Ashutosh Ranka among donors

item.title: Beats of an old custom fade away from Keralam’s courts
item.description: Following a campaign by a rights activist, High Court’s Rules Committee decides to remove provision for the 'tom-tom' and 'kinnam mutti vilambaram' used to inform public about property attachment proceedings. The tradition, which goes back to the days of princely rule, survived the colonial period and is still prevalent in some courts

item.title: One dead, another injured while cleaning sewer in Santacruz; no safety gear provided: Police
item.description: Police identified the deceased as Santosh Ganpat Kashte, 47, and the injured worker as Ajay Dhyanchand Thakur, 26

item.title: Supreme Court questions FSSAI for delay in roll-out of warning labels on packaged foods
item.description: ‘You started in 2022. What did you do in the last four years,’ the Bench asks the food safety regulator as it seeks nearly two years to roll out front-of-pack warning labels on packaged foods

item.title: Why Rayalaseema farmers fear a bumper crop more than drought; can the ₹1-lakh-crore horticulture hub change that?
item.description: Farmers in the region fear a bumper yield the most, because the lack of cold storage and market linkages and exploitation by middlemen often force them into distress sales

item.title: ED raids premises of ex-West Bengal minister, others in PMLA case
item.description: A total of 15 premises were covered during the raids conducted in connection with alleged financial irregularities in an organisation that ran Durga Puja preview shows, they said

item.title: Why rare-disease drugs could become India’s next pharma frontier
item.description: Since India has already shown the world how to make drugs affordable, the next challenge is to show the world how to make rare-disease drugs accessible; with a streamlined regulatory pathway, appropriate financial incentives, and government procurement, India could build a globally competitive rare-disease pharmaceutical sector

item.title: 20-year-old youth abducted in broad daylight in Bihar’s Supaul
item.description: When villagers tried to chase the kidnappers, they opened fire on them to create panic. The police have recovered a used cartridge from the place of the incident

item.title: Delhi announces vehicle curbs, work-from-home, construction bans for winter pollution

item.description: He has been practising power lifting for nearly five years now
